name: eco
description: ECO connects ChatGPT Web and Codex Desktop to the latest lnwjud-compatible Windows runtime through headless MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Use ECO headless MCP with local Windows projects
interface.longDescription: ECO routes ChatGPT Web through Secure MCP Tunnel and lets Codex Desktop use the same headless stdio MCP runtime. Files, Git, processes, browser, Windows automation, Office, WSL, recovery, tasks, and other capabilities remain in the upstream-derived lnwjud runtime under shared workspace, permission, and safety boundaries; lnwjud Desktop/Electron is not required.
defaultPrompt: Use ECO to inspect the active project and summarize its Git status without making changes.
Use ECO to implement this change, run focused tests, and show the resulting Git diff.
Use ECO to inspect the Windows target first, then perform only the requested action.
